review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description : (3-5 years) We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to join our global team and help design, implement, and maintain our private and public cloud infrastructure. This role involves contributing to the maintenance and operation of network components, with a focus on building smart, scalable, and easy to maintain automated solutions. Key Responsibilities : Deploy, configure, maintain, troubleshoot and optimize network infrastructure. Collaborate with senior engineers, architect
eligibility_evidence: Collaborate closely with onsite engineers to support network installations, troubleshooting, and maintenance as needed.

We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: They should also be comfortable working in a Linux environment, and proficient at network automation and using configuration management and automation tools such as Git and Ansible. Collaborate with senior engineers, architecture and engineering teams to implement network requirements and support organisational objectives. Required Skills & Experience: 3+ years of experience in a network engineering role, ideally within a large-scale enterprise or cloud service provider network. Good proficiency in network security, and experience working with NGFW firewalls. Strong Grafana proficiency: building and maintaining custom metric exporters and integrating externally provided exporters; designing dashboards; and managing alerting configuration as code, deployed via Terraform. Proficient working with Linux operating systems. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools
